# Departure Mono VN v1.003

First public Vietnamese release, based on **Departure Mono 1.500**.

**Vietnamese adaptation by [tuantm](https://github.com/tuanxtm).**
Original typeface by [Helena Zhang](https://helenazhang.com), from
[rektdeckard/departure-mono](https://github.com/rektdeckard/departure-mono).
The original specimen website is by Helena Zhang and Tobias Fried.

## What's included

- **76 added Vietnamese letters**, completing **134 Vietnamese-specific characters** (67 lowercase and 67 uppercase).
- Two additional combining marks: hook above and horn.
- **1,264 glyphs** and **1,157 mapped Unicode code points** in total.
- Support for precomposed (NFC) and decomposed (NFD) Vietnamese input.
- The original 350-unit monospace advance and 50-unit pixel grid.
- Compact three-pixel breve and hook marks; corrected hook height on lowercase `ỉ`.
- OTF, TTF, WOFF and WOFF2, with original author/license metadata preserved and review-kit branding removed.

## Installation

Download the ZIP for all four formats, credits, the OFL license and sample text,
or download an individual font file below. Install **either OTF or TTF** for
desktop use; use WOFF/WOFF2 for websites.

The installed font family remains **Departure Mono**. Close your applications
and uninstall an older build before installing. Font sizes in multiples of
**11px** preserve pixel alignment. Default line metrics are about **35.7%** taller
than upstream to fit stacked uppercase accents.

## Validation

All four files passed the font compatibility gate and loaded in Chromium.
Checks cover outlines, fixed advances, NFC/NFD shaping, clipping metrics,
metadata, release checksums and archive integrity. Desktop applications have
not all been tested manually.

The font and Vietnamese modifications are licensed under **SIL OFL 1.1**. This is
a derivative adaptation, not an official upstream release. The Vietnamese
version number is independent of the upstream font's version number.
